name: Dumbbell Lying Curl
steps: Lie face up on a flat bench with feet planted flat on the floor.
Hold a dumbbell in each hand palms up, letting your arms hang straight off the sides of the bench.
Keep your upper arms stationary as you bend both elbows to curl the dumbbells toward your shoulders.
Lower both dumbbells slowly over the edges of the bench until your arms extend.
tips: Keep your shoulders supported on the pad and your wrists straight.
Avoid swinging your elbows forward as you lift the dumbbells from the stretch.
